rv.q: And now another respectable dramatization of the Arthurian Legend has emerged.
THE LAST QUEEN OF CAMELOT is more just CAMELOT than the Queen's retrospective.
It is a triumphant theatrical accomplishment.
While the first act is very good, the second act is great.

cn.t: Jackson's fresh adaptation breathes new life into Arthurian legend with a feminist lens, centering strong female characters like Guinevere and Morgan le Fay while employing skillful Shakespearean-style dialogue.
